Name: Amanita Lover
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[size=3][i][center][color=#fff2cc]Ever wanted Red Mushoom had more usage? Ever wanted Heater had more usage? This mod satisfy those two wishes! [/color][/center][/i][/size][center][size=3]------------------------------------------[/size][/center]
[color=#f4cccc][size=2][center](This mod DOES NOT encourage anyone to try eating amanita mushrooms in real life, nor does it aimed to recreate the exact real life recipes for amanita related artisan goods!). Also this mod is made for Stardew 1.6 and higher (won't work on Stardew 1.5.6)[/center][/size][/color]
[b][center][size=3]This mod adds 3 new special items, artisan goods and cooking recipes made with vanilla Red Mushooom item:[/size][/center][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]You can now dry Red Mushrooms using  vanilla Dehydrator (added in 1.6 stardew) or Heater machine (yes, the one you usually place in your coop\barn and forget about it). [/size]
[*][size=3]Dehydrator will produce the dried caps within 10 minutes[/size]
[*][size=3]Heater will produce the dried caps within 1 day[/size]
[*][size=3]The mechanic is similar to how you would use kegs and preserving jars - just put 3 Red Mushrooms  into it and you'll get one Dried Mushroom Caps item the next day.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
This mod also adds a couple of new Red Mushroom related events for unlocking new recipes (the funny ones...).
[center]------------------------------------------[/center][b][center]ITEMS:[/center][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][b][color=#b6d7a8]Dried Amanita Caps[/color][/b] - red mushroom caps that you can get by drying 3 vanilla Red Mushrooms in Heater for one day [u](yes, you need to have 3 mushrooms in your inventory to put it in heater)[/u]. Drying will reduce some of it's negative effects and give some buffs for short period of time upon eating. (+2 speed, +5 attack +nausea for 1 min)[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b][color=#b6d7a8]Amanita Tea[/color][/b] - a brew made out of 3 dried amania caps. Will give you Adrenaline and Warrior buffs. (+2 speed, +10 attack  for 2 min)[/size]
[/list][size=3][b]HOW TO ULOCK[/b] (spoilers): [spoiler] Reach level 4 Combat skill and visit Mines - you'll see the event in which Marlon will invite you in Adventure Guild to teach you the recipe. [/spoiler] 

[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b][color=#b6d7a8]Amanita Tincture[/color][/b] - a tincture made out of 3 dried amanita caps, 1 bottle of wine and 3 ginger. Will give you Adrenaline and Warrior buffs for longer time. (+2 speed, +10 attack  for 3.5 min)[/size]
[/list][size=3][b]HOW TO ULOCK[/b] (spoilers): [spoiler]  Reach level 8 Combat skill and visit Wizard's Tower - you'll see the event in which Wizard will teach you the recipe. [/spoiler] 

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]If you have my other mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18109]Distant Lands[/url]﻿ installed, you also get 3 additional recipes for Brown Amanita (those items will give you slightly longer buff duration than the Red Amanita ones)[/size]
[/list][size=3][center]------------------------------------------[/center][b]Note that you will encounter some minor bug with heater[/b] - during winter season Heater will always turn on automatically, so in order to put mushrooms in it, hit it with any tool to pick it up and place again, and then put mushrooms in it.
[center]------------------------------------------[/center][/size][center][/center]

Downloads.Description:
fixed issue when recipes weren't added after player saw both marlon and wizard events
fixed smapi error during one of the events
tea and tinctures are now in "cooking" category
caps are now in "artisan" category
changed tea buff duration to 1 min
